gate.again: Get a new link with /mysaba web on Discord.
gate.link_invalid: This link was already used or has expired.
gate.host_unreachable: Couldn't reach your PC. Check that the PC and the Saba-chan app are on and up to date.
gate.session_gone: The session ended, so it couldn't reconnect.
gate.left: The session ended because you left the page.
gate.replaced: A new session was opened elsewhere, so this one ended.
gate.host_gone: The connection to your PC was lost.
gate.relay_closing: The session ended for server maintenance.
gate.connection_lost: The session ended because the connection was lost.

session.ending_soon: The session ends soon. Tap Extend to keep going.

provision.pc_needed: This needs to be confirmed in the Saba-chan app on the PC.
provision.dismiss_hint: If this was a new server, closing also deletes it.

servers.add_hint: Set PC settings such as the executable location in the Saba-chan app.
servers.name: Name
servers.no_modules: No game modules are installed. Install one in the Modules tab first.
servers.trust_unverified: This module is not from the official catalog. Its Python scripts run isolated, but the game server it installs and runs is not isolated and runs with your account's permissions. Only continue if you trust this module.
servers.trust_modified: This module's files changed after installing from the official catalog. Its Python scripts run isolated, but the game server it installs and runs is not isolated and runs with your account's permissions. Only continue if you trust this module.
servers.restart_message: Connected players will be briefly disconnected.
servers.delete_message: The server settings and files will be deleted. This can't be undone.
servers.version_hint: Only versions the chosen server type offers are listed.
servers.run_managed_hint: saba-chan runs the server process, so you get the console, logs and auto restart.
servers.run_unmanaged_hint: saba-chan starts the server and only watches whether it is running. The saba-chan console is not available, and on Windows the server opens in its own console window.
servers.port_in_use: {{servers}} also uses port {{port}}. The ports clash if both run at once.
servers.location_pc: Server files go into saba-chan's folder. To use another folder, create the server in the saba-chan app on the PC.
servers.pick: Pick a server on the left.
servers.order_hint: Drag a handle or use ▲▼, then save.

settings.name_taken: A server with that name already exists.
settings.none: This game has no settings to change.
settings.pc_only: Only the Saba-chan app on the PC can change this.
settings.saved_restart: Settings saved. Some apply after the server restarts.
settings.changed_elsewhere: The settings were changed elsewhere in the meantime. Load the new values, then make your change again.
settings.delete_hint: Deletes the server settings and files.

backups.restore_message: The current files will go back to {{name}}.

agreements.title: Agreement required
agreements.message:
To start {{name}}, you need to accept these terms.
{{list}}

perm.no_guilds: No Discord servers are connected to this PC.
perm.default_hint: The level for everyone not set below.
perm.ladder_hint: Higher rows are stronger levels. Owner and Blocked stay in place. Edit a name in its box. Owner, Guest and Blocked can't be deleted. To swap commands, press "Swap permissions" below and pick two levels.
perm.ladder_removed: People on deleted levels move to the level just below. Commands that needed them move to the level just above.
perm.notice_hint: Servers turned on here are announced in this Discord server's alert channel when they start or stop without a Discord command (app, web, CLI, schedule, auto restart, in game, crash). Starts and stops from Discord are left out.
perm.notice_empty: This Discord server uses no servers.
perm.full_notice_hint: Servers turned on here are announced in this Discord server's alert channel when they fill up or a slot opens again.
perm.instances_hint: Open an instance to see commands per level and each member's level.
perm.members_server_wide: Member levels apply to every instance on this Discord server.
perm.stairs_failed: Couldn't load or save permissions. Make sure saba-chan is running, then refresh.
perm.preset_reset: {{count}} command level(s) will be reset to the {{preset}} preset.
perm.moved_count: {{count}} command(s) moved away from the preset
perm.help_hint: help and list are open to every level except banned, and can't be changed.
perm.fixed_hint: This command affects the whole PC, so its level can't be changed.
perm.risk_pc_hint: The word on the right is the Discord confirm step. Change it in the PC app.
perm.visible: Servers shown in this Discord server
perm.visible_hint: Servers you turn off disappear from this Discord server's slash and prefix commands.

modules.busy: Another task for this module isn't finished. Try again in a moment.
modules.official_only: On the web, you can install only officially published releases.
modules.catalog_failed: Couldn't get the published list. Open this again in a moment.
modules.check_failed: Could not get the check result.
modules.check_undeclared: Check: uses features not declared by the module ({{perms}}). Make sure you trust this module.

plugins.in_use: A running server uses this plugin. Stop the server and try again.
plugins.settings_pc_only: Plugin settings may hold secrets, so change them in the saba-chan app on the PC.

more.pc_only_note: Updates, paths, Discord connection and chatbot settings are done in the Saba-chan app on the PC.
more.activity_desc: Shows who did what to your servers, when and from where. PC paths are hidden.
more.screen_note: Saved only in this browser. The app settings on the PC don't change.

errors.remote_not_allowed: This can only be done in the Saba-chan app on the PC.
errors.remote_field_blocked: These settings can only be changed on the PC: {{fields}}
errors.remote_timeout: It didn't finish within 2 minutes, so it was treated as a failure. Check the result on the PC.
errors.remote_host_gone: The connection to the PC was lost before the request finished.
errors.remote_busy: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.

port_check.address: Public IP {{address}} (friends join with this address and the port)

verdict.router: Port forwarding is not set up on the router
verdict.cgnat: Your router has no public IP (CGNAT)
verdict.unknown: Some ports could not be checked
verdict.no_ports: This game does not say which ports to check

hint.closed: Check that your router forwards this port to this PC and that the PC firewall allows it.
hint.firewall: Windows Firewall is blocking incoming connections on this port. For the network you are connected to now (private or public), allow saba-core if the server is stopped, or the game server program if it is running, in Windows Firewall settings, then check again.
hint.router: The PC firewall allows this port. Forward this port to this PC in your router settings, then check again.
hint.cgnat: Your provider shares one public IP among many homes, so port forwarding cannot open it. Ask your provider for a public IP or use a VPN such as Tailscale.
hint.unknown: UDP ports of a running server and ports another program uses cannot be checked. Stop the server and check again.

error.node_token_missing: Connect to Discord (pairing) first. Server-chan does the check.
error.port_check_busy: A check is already running. Try again in a moment.
error.rate_limited: Too many checks. Try again in a minute.
error.relay_unreachable: Could not reach Server-chan. Check your internet connection.

players.stopped: Start the server to see who is online.
players.unsupported: This game does not report who is online.

check.update_unsupported: This server's install method can't check for updates here.
check.update_confirm: Update the game server '{{name}}'? A backup is made first.

no_pc.band: Install the Saba-chan app on a PC to manage game servers and modules here too.
no_pc.title: This needs a PC
no_pc.text: Game servers and modules run on a PC with the Saba-chan app installed.
no_pc.step_download: Download the app on your PC:
no_pc.step_connect: Open the app and run /saba connect in Discord.
no_pc.step_link: Get a new link with /saba web and this tab opens.

relay.big_emoji_hint: A message with only a custom emoji is posted larger
relay.game_chat_guard: Block messages while chat link is off
relay.game_chat_guard_hint: Removes plain messages in the game chat channel (replies and call-word messages stay)
relay.game_chat_clear_on_stop: Clear chat when the server stops
relay.game_chat_clear_on_stop_hint: Removes that server's game chat from while it ran
relay.music_ui_hint: Shows the now-playing panel in the assigned channel
relay.api_key_hint: The key is never shown again after saving.
relay.memory_clear_hint: Removes everything Saba-chan remembered in this server
relay.pc_channels_hint: These come from a PC, so you can assign them after connecting one
relay.no_guilds: There are no Discord servers you can manage.
relay.other_pc: This server is connected to another PC. Change it from that PC's /saba web link.

err.NEEDS_PC: Connect a PC to change this.
err.PC_OWNED: A PC handles this server. Change it from the PC's link.
err.RATE_LIMITED: Too many changes. Try again in a moment.
err.FORBIDDEN: You don't have the Discord permission for this.
err.BOT_MISSING_PERMISSION: Saba-chan is missing a Discord permission it needs.
err.MUTE_CANNOT: This person's mute can't be lifted.
err.SANCTION_NOT_MEMBER: This person isn't in the server. Only a ban works for them.
err.SANCTION_CANNOT: Saba-chan's role is lower than this person's.
err.SANCTION_TOO_LONG: A timeout can be at most 28 days.
err.CLEAR_RUNNING: This channel is already being cleared.
err.NO_CLEAR_JOB: Nothing is being cleared in this channel.
err.generic: Couldn't change it. Try again in a moment.

mod.title: Server management
mod.slow_for_hint: When it ends, the interval goes back to what it was before.
mod.slow_ends: Ends in {{time}}, then goes back to the earlier interval.
mod.auto_daily_hint: Every day at {{time}} (server time zone), clears messages written before then.
mod.clear_count_hint: Leave empty to clear to the end.
mod.clear_hint: Messages older than 14 days are deleted one by one, so it can take a while. It's the same job as the progress message in the Discord channel.
mod.member_hint: Searches server members. A ban also works with a user ID for someone not in the server.
mod.kind_chat_hint: Blocks only posting, with a 'chat restricted' role.
mod.kind_ban_hint: Bans them from the server. A timed ban is lifted when it ends.
mod.announce_hint: The result is also posted in the server's system channel (without pinging anyone).

relay.load_failed: Couldn't load the settings. Check the connection and try again.
relay.guilds_failed: Couldn't load your Discord servers. Check the connection and try again.
relay.api_key_pc_hint: This is this PC's key. Every Discord server linked to this PC shares it.
relay.basics_desc: Language and emoji for this server
relay.reading_desc: Reads chat aloud in voice channels
relay.channels_desc: Pick a channel for each feature

logs.title: Past logs
logs.empty: No logs yet. They appear after the server runs once.
logs.exported_truncated: The log was too long, so only the latest part was downloaded.
